title: Facial soft-tissue thickness (forensic tissue depth tables)

queue.claim: Pooled adult FSTT means used as engine defaults: glabella ~5.5, nasion ~6-6.5, rhinion ~3, mid-philtrum ~11-12, pogonion ~11, gnathion ~8, menton ~7, gonion ~11-12, mid-masseter/occlusal ~17-19 mm (Stephan T-table / 2018 tally)
queue.query: Stephan 2018 tallied facial soft tissue thicknesses adults T-table mean glabella nasion rhinion pogonion gonion mm

queue.claim: Rhine & Moore 1984 American Caucasoid normal-build values, e.g. male supraglabella 4.25, glabella 5.25, nasion 6.5, end of nasals 3.0, mid-philtrum 10.0, inferior malar 13.25, gonion 11.5, supra-M2 19.5, occlusal line 18.25; female glabella 4.75, nasion 5.5, gonion 12.0
queue.query: Rhine Moore 1984 facial tissue thickness American Caucasoids table supraglabella 4.25 glabella 5.25 nasion 6.50 male normal

queue.claim: BMI effect magnitudes: ~0.1-0.2 mm per BMI unit at thin midline sites and ~0.3-0.7 mm per unit at cheek/jaw/submental (beta_bmi 0.01-0.05 log-units); De Greef 2006 was ultrasound on 967 adults at ~52 landmarks stratified by BMI and age
queue.query: De Greef 2006 large-scale in vivo Caucasian facial soft tissue thickness database ultrasound 967 BMI age landmarks

queue.claim: Sex differences depend on the site: men +1 to +2.5 mm at philtrum and lips; women equal or thicker at inferior malar, infraorbital and gonion (delta_sex defaults)
queue.query: facial soft tissue thickness sex differences females thicker malar gonion males thicker philtrum lips CT CBCT study
